name: live-progress
description: A band above the prompt: what runs now (tool calls, background builds and tests, subagents) with a progress bar by learned ETA, redrawn locally, no model tokens.

clawd.title: Clawd in the terminal
clawd.description: Draw Clawd walking above each progress bar in the CLI. Off: only the bar and the job's label, two rows a job, so more jobs fit. The desktop app always draws him.

taskHooks.title: Quick end of background tasks
taskHooks.description: Also hook session.append, classic.Stop and classic.SubagentStop, so a background task leaves the band soon after it ends, also when no notification the mod can read comes. Turn off where a managed plugin makes Claude Code show 'live-progress … hook was skipped' lines: background tasks then end on their notification, or far past their usual time.
